title: Advanced Environmental Topics in Ecological Restoration
description:
A focused, in-depth systematic examination of specific environmental areas through seminars and projects; the development of appropriate responses to questions and problems within the selected areas; modes of interaction and communication with professional and community groups; application of theory to practice; qualitative vs. quantitative research methods. These courses are conducted as seminars and may include a field trip for which a fee is charged.
* Contact hours may vary depending on the topic.
notes: May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
